source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check the BMC heart beat LED on the board.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: The LED should be GREEN with and match the spec flash frequency.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: BMC heart beat LED is a physical/visual check of the BMC heart-beat LED color/flash-frequency on the board; the agent cannot see the LED over SSH.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator records the BMC heart-beat LED (should be GREEN with the spec flash frequency); agent cannot see LEDs.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: LED inspection is physical/visual - human only.

original_test_intent: Visually verify the on-board BMC heartbeat indicator is green and blinks at the platform-specified frequency.
original_method: A qualified engineer locates the board LED and observes or records its color and blink period.
manual_activity: The core acceptance is a physical visual/optical observation performed by an engineer; the agent may catalog supplied media but cannot claim it saw the LED.
required_inputs: Safe access and photo/video measurement method
safety_requirements: Follow ESD and energized-board access rules.
Do not touch the board or confuse adjacent LEDs.
Do not infer physical blinking from software health alone.
agent_execution_scope: Organize timestamped photo/video or optical measurement and correlate BMC identity/logs.
Do not certify visual state or verdict.
engineer_actions: Compare with spec and decide verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no remote command can replace physical LED observation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep the manual method; optional offline video timing is supporting evidence only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Green color, spec flash frequency and 5/5 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record the identified LED with a timestamped video long enough for multiple periods and measure blink interval against the approved tolerance.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware and board revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds repeatable optical timing and identity evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not substitute software state for physical indication.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera exposure can misrepresent color or duty cycle.

project_override_considerations: Project optical instrumentation is acceptable if an engineer confirms the target LED; software-only telemetry is not equivalent.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria align on the heartbeat LED; missing frequency value is a specification input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is executable manually once the board specification is supplied; manual core acceptance is not BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds optical evidence while preserving claim boundary.

review_improvement: Makes blink-frequency evidence measurable without pretending software can see the LED.
independent_technical_reasoning: Color and physical blink frequency are optical properties; BMC software health cannot prove the board indicator circuitry, so engineer observation is indispensable.
